component.name: Task Manager
Gestionnaire des tâches
مدير المهام
component.summary: Monitor system resources, processes and services
Surveiller les ressources système, les processus et les services

description.p: Task Manager monitors CPU, memory, disk, GPU and network utilization with live graphs and per-logical-core breakdowns. It lists running processes and systemd services with sortable tables, search filtering, and a detail inspector.

Processes can be ended (SIGTERM) or force-killed (SIGKILL) through a confirmation dialog. Protected system processes and services are guarded from accidental termination. Service logs are viewable from the journal.
